body:

[Jklaro] Ill only buy with data. Too many cables at home that dont have data.
[ATangk] This still is USB 2.0, can do data just slow.
[Jklaro] Just that i got an external monitor and none of my usb can output the video signal. Quite frustrating especially when you cant easily know by looking at the cable. And when you think oh this is a good high quality cable.
[coxymla] I'd like to agree with this idea, but a USB 3 cable is still rare and expensive for some reason.
[Clear] With the USB specifications after a 100W rated cable comes 240W. There's plenty of devices around that charge at higher than 100W.
[AustriaBargain] MacBook charges at 140W, though only by their special MagSafe to USB C cable. But the USB C end must be rated for at least 140W.
[abowen] Laptops
No doubt as it comes more mainstream, more devices
[shoppe] External portable monitor. Doesn't need a separate power cable just uses usb-c cable.
[Mr Simple] Expired? I don’t see that prove for 3+3m
[kizzaaa] Just checked it…
Under $21.59 it says
Save 40% at checkout
So when you check out you will pay $12.95
[Salesniper] @kizzaaa: My rural address still shows full price at checkout, metro address has the discounted 40%
[Ehty] Waiting for these for long https://amzn.asia/d/0enjJ1EO
[DealsPlzz] You may try this.. https://amzn.asia/d/0hqtBP6v
I haven't bought any of these, so no idea how cool they are.
[toadbload] These don't have an e marker chip and can't achieve 240W, so it's actual maximum charging speed is 60W.
But $13 for two 60W 3m cables isn't a bad deal
[Misha Bakunin] Don't know what that is but I think you just saved me from an impulse buy thankyou
[kizzaaa] I'm using a Lisen cable now that has negotiated 100W on my MBP, which confirms there's an e-marker chip in the one I'm using.
The Ozbargainer was using a FNB58 tester, whereas testing with KM003C shows there is an e-marker present. There's a few reddit threads about this. Apparently it was a faulty batch of Lisen cables where the e-marker wasn't wired to the opposing CC/VCONN pins.
If you get a faulty one, amazon's return process is easy.
[toadbload] can't say anything about how you've gotten 100w, but i've tested mine on a dell xps 2021 and an m1 mbp 16, both didn't charge at 100w according to the laptop its self, the only device i saw it go near 100w was on a hs02 soldering iron reaching 93w briefly, but that also pulls 100w on a cheap cable i'm sure doesn't have an e marker, so probably not the most reliable device
I tested mine on an fnb58(latest firmware, from around may this year), the author of the comment doesn't specify. I purchased the cables twice last year once in may and july which i tested all 4, 6 months after Ziginox from the reddit thread. And i can't find anything about a faulty batch.
Zigniox who tested it with the KM003C does say this on the thread :
FWIW, I've tested a lot of cables, and it reads e-markers 100% of the time on cables that don't do weird things.
and on another about lisen cables :
My FNB58 can't read the e-marker, as a result, although the KM003C can. It seems to work in actual practice, but clearly they didn't do it right.
Short answer, no, probably not.
Either the issue might have been fixed in the past year or i'm just unlucky with my cables and getting them to work
[srr] You are absolutely correct. I also tested the cables and they don’t have the chip. Also, the cables look thin and flimsy.
[Homr] no i didnt, i have now. Thank you bought
[edrift] Has anyone had issues with 3m long cables before? Last time I bought some, not this brand, only my Samsung charger fast charged with them.
My other fast chargers (IKEA and Bunnings click car charger) wouldn't fast charge.
[Hector] Great cords for power. Terrible for file transfer speed.
Plugs are ok sturdy, but we bent one when my phone fell off my bed
We use these bedside to charge and read at night
240W and fast data cables too thick
